title: Abonelik ve rol dogrulama
purpose: Implements FR-E1-06: Post-login subscription status sync, plan_owner/plan_member role assignment, and paywall display for non-subscribers on Library/Progress tabs.

loading.description: Spinner with 'Abonelik durumu kontrol ediliyor...' while syncing subscription from server.

ready.description: Subscription badge and role indicator shown. Non-subscribers see paywall prompt with subscribe CTA.

empty.description: Message explaining no subscription info found, with a link to plans page or retry.

error.description: Banner explaining subscription check failed, with reason and retry. Cached status used if available.

offline.description: Last-known subscription status and role displayed from cache. Sync status indicator shown.
